source_full_text: And only begged to be allowed to put a test to the two young men to prove which was the real prince. The king, who was feeling much ashamed of the rage he had been in with his dear wife, consented at once, and she said No doubt others would make them ride or shoot, or something of that sort, But every one learns these things.
